title: Bias library (3): six niche biases
objectives: Recognise sunk cost, status quo, regret aversion, familiarity, hindsight and myopic loss aversion.
Answer each with the manual's “what to say” line.
body_md:
Sunk cost: “I've held this 5 years, I can't exit now.” Say: “The past years are spent. Is it the best fund for the next five?” Status quo / inertia: “My money is fine in savings for now.” Say: “Doing nothing is also a decision, and inflation charges for it.” Regret aversion: “What if I invest and it falls tomorrow?” Say: “Let's stagger it through an STP so no single day decides the outcome.” Familiarity / home bias: “Most of my money is in my company's shares.” Say: “Your salary already depends on that company. Let's not put your savings on the same bet.” Hindsight: “It was obvious the market would crash.” Say: “It always looks obvious afterwards. That's why we plan, not predict.” Myopic loss aversion: “I check daily and it stresses me.” Say: “Let's look quarterly. Daily moves are noise for a 10-year goal.”

| Bias | How it sounds | What to say |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sunk cost | "I've held this 5 years, I can't exit now." | "The past years are spent. Is it the best fund for the next five?" |
| Status quo / inertia | "My money is fine in savings for now." | "Doing nothing is also a decision, and inflation charges for it." |
| Regret aversion | "What if I invest and it falls tomorrow?" | "Let's stagger it through an STP so no single day decides the outcome." |
| Familiarity / home bias | "Most of my money is in my company's shares." | "Your salary already depends on that company. Let's not put your savings on the same bet." |
| Hindsight | "It was obvious the market would crash." | "It always looks obvious afterwards. That's why we plan, not predict." |
| Myopic loss aversion | "I check daily and it stresses me." | "Let's look quarterly. Daily moves are noise for a 10-year goal." |
example: “I've held this 5 years, I can't exit now” → sunk cost: the past years are spent; is it the best fund for the next five?
say: Doing nothing is also a decision, and inflation charges for it.
never: Past years justify keeping a bad fund.
Daily moves matter most for a 10-year goal.

check.q: "I've held this fund for 5 years, I can't exit now." Which bias?
check.why: Sunk cost. Past investment is spent; the question is the next five years.

check.q: "My money is fine in savings for now." Which bias?
check.why: Status quo / inertia. Doing nothing feels safe but has a cost.

check.q: “My money is fine in savings for now” is:
check.why: Status quo / inertia: “My money is fine in savings for now.” Say: “Doing nothing is also a decision, and inflation charges for it.”
